title: Maxwell and Epstein meet Castro for permission to dive the site

tellings.quote: disappears from the media. Now Glenn Maxwell went down to Cuba and met with Fidel Castro together with Epstein to get permission to dive on this site.

plain: A person he calls Maxwell went to Cuba with Jeffrey Epstein and met Fidel Castro to get permission to dive on an underwater site. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells this on the show as something he has heard, saying the site had earlier dropped out of the news. He tells it as a hint that powerful people took a secret interest in the site.
